An '''assault gunship''' was a type of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used as an [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]].<ref name="TEGtVaV" />

A [[Blastboat/Legends|blastboat]] was a type of assault gunship that packed weapon loads nearly the equivalent of a small [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] in a heavy [[Starfighter/Legends|startighter]] frame.<ref name="FF129" />
